AUTOPSY LOG — SUBJECT W-4411 (guard, deceased)

External: crude surgical intervention post-mortem. Incisions closed with black cord of unknown composition. The work is confident. Practiced. Almost caring.

Internal: [see attached — attachment missing]

Note from examining physician: the subject's heart shows no cause of arrest. It simply stopped, completely and simultaneously in every fiber, the way a machine stops when someone flips its switch.

Subject W-4411 was logged banging on the morgue drawer from the inside six hours after this examination. Reclassified SCP-049-2. The examining physician has requested transfer. Request denied — we need her here.
